text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @oncall — sev: critical. Release 2026-03-15-canary shows DB migration error on canary-cluster causing write failures and HTTP 500s. Error pattern: enum type mismatch and stuck migration process. Please ack.

Zoe L: ack. I'm oncall. seeing increased 500s from api-canary with spike at 16:40 UTC. Rolling errors reference orders.status enum.

Arjun P: I kicked the canary rollout earlier with a small enum migration: `CREATE TYPE order_status_v2 AS ENUM ('pending','paid','shipped','archived'); ALTER TABLE orders ALTER COLUMN status TYPE order_status_v2 USING (status::text::order_status_v2);` Logs show `ERROR:  invalid input value for enum order_status_v2: "in_transit"` and migration process hung retrying.

Kira M: enum casts fail if any row has a value outside new enum. That will abort transaction and leave migration process in retry/backoff loop if it's scripted. Can you paste the failing row sample?

Arjun P: here's psql output from canary-db-1: ```SELECT status, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status; status | count -----+------- pending | 1200 paid | 3100 shipped | 27 in_transit | 5 cancelled | 2``` The new enum didn't include `in_transit` or `cancelled`. Oops.

Sam R: customer impact: two customers on canary report checkout failures and order stuck errors. CS escalations opened. ETA to rollback?

Arjun P: options: 1) patch migration to include missing values before type cast (fast) 2) back out deployment and route canary traffic to stable (safer) 3) abort migration and run row-level cleanup then try again.

Zoe L: immediate mitigation: we should stop sending canary traffic to new release to prevent more failures. Arjun, can you flip the route flag?

Arjun P: flipping canary off via deploy-bot: `deploy-bot set-canary-weight 0` -> deploy-bot: acknowledged, canary weight set to 0% (propagation ~10s).

deploy-bot: auto message — canary weight change complete.

Sam R: CS note sent: "We've routed your traffic back to the stable service; we're investigating a schema mismatch in a canary migration. No action required on your side." Customers acknowledge.

Kira M: routing to 0% prevents new writes with problematic schema, but the migration process is still holding resources and retrying on canary DB, causing CPU spikes. We should stop the migration job to prevent further retries.

Arjun P: killing migration process now (migration-runner id 20260315-enum-9) on canary: `ps aux | grep migration-runner` PID 3344. Sending SIGTERM.

Arjun P: SIGTERM didn't exit cleanly (runner traps and restarts). It's managed by systemd-like supervisor — disabling service now: `supervisorctl stop migration-runner` -> stopped. Migration job no longer running.

Kira M: good. Next, to avoid data drift, we need to either add missing enum values or sanitize rows. Since values are legitimate business states, easiest is to patch enum then re-run. I'll prepare `ALTER TYPE order_status_v2 ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'in_transit'; ALTER TYPE order_status_v2 ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'cancelled';` But note: ALTER TYPE ADD VALUE is not transactional and must be run carefully.

Zoe L: do we need DBA approval? Any risk to stable prod? This is limited to canary cluster but types are global per database; ensure we target the canary DB only.

Kira M: confirmed — this is canary DB instance only. Running now on canary-db-1 with immediate replication paused. Command executed: `ALTER TYPE order_status_v2 ADD VALUE 'in_transit'; ALTER TYPE order_status_v2 ADD VALUE 'cancelled';` -> completed.

Arjun P: after adding values restarted migration-runner to run a patched migration script that uses `ALTER COLUMN TYPE` with a safe cast path. Starting runner now.

Arjun P: runner logs: `attempting cast -> converting 5 rows with legacy values -> completed conversion for in_transit/cancelled -> ALTER TABLE... succeeded`. Migration completed on canary at 2754322315.

Sam R: CS update: customers confirm degraded behavior resolved. No new errors in last 4m.

Zoe L: actions going forward: - update deploy checklist to validate enum coverage before casting - add preflight check script that validates distinct values in the target column against new enum set and fail the run early - add supervisor rule to not auto-restart migrations in failed state without manual acknowledgement - create alert if migration process restarts >3 times in 10m on canary cluster

Kira M: also note we should avoid running `ALTER TYPE ... ADD VALUE` under heavy load; schedule maintenance windows or use translation mapping approach. Will open PR with safe migration pattern.

Arjun P: I'll open emergency PR to include preflight check and `--dry-run` mode in migration-runner.

Zoe L: post-incident: who owns customer comms wrap? Sam?

Sam R: I'll send final note confirming incident resolved and follow-up doc coming.

incident-bot: incident status changed to mitigated — canary traffic routed back to stable and problematic migration stopped. Recovery: ongoing (migration re-run on canary completed).

Arjun P: migration success confirmed against canary DB. I'll schedule a controlled staged rollout for the enum migration with prechecks in place.

Zoe L: closing the live incident channel. Please file a short postmortem in the incidents tracker and link to PRs for preflight checks and supervisor config change.

Sam R: will do final customer email and close CS tickets.

Kira M: creating follow-up tickets: MIG-112 add preflight enum check, OPS-401 supervisor restart policy, ALERT-77 migration-repeat-rate.

Zoe L: thanks everyone. Leaving thread open for postmortem notes until doc created.
